profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary: Seasoned software developer with over 20 years of experience developing storage-related software and solutions, with a special focus on high-performance software designs.  Proven track record of leadership and strong technical contributions in open-source projects and communities.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Storage Performance Development Kit (SPDK) – Software Architect and Core Maintainer (2013-2023)
•	Established initial vision for userspace polled-mode framework for NVMe-based storage applications
•	Built SPDK reputation as an industry-critical and collaborative open-source community, resulting in contributions from over 350 committers from over 80 companies since 2015
•	Responsible for setting architectural direction for the project, expanding scope from direct-attached NVMe to a broad range of use cases including storage networking, storage virtualization and infrastructure offload
•	Worked closely with engineering and marketing teams across Intel, to ensure alignment on Intel SPDK focus based on product needs (CPUs, SSDs, NICs, IPUs) and customer-specific requests.
•	Provided technical leadership and mentoring while growing Intel SPDK team across three geos (Chandler, Gdansk, Shanghai), including four SPDK core maintainers.
 
FreeBSD – src committer and lead Intel contributor (2011-2018)
•	Authored NVMe support including drivers and utilities, enabling NVMe SSD consumption in Netflix Open Connect CDN responsible for vast majority of Netflix internet traffic
•	Authored FreeBSD support to support Intel business across multiple groups, including Intel® VTune, PCM, C600 SAS controller (isci), Atom SMBus 2.0 (ismt)

Additional Roles at Intel:
•	Intel® RSTe Windows Driver Technical Lead (2009-2011)
•	RAID-on-CPU Pathfinding Technical Lead (2007-2009)
•	Intel® IOP348 (Sunrise Lake) Firmware Performance Lead (2006-2007)
•	Intel® XScale Storage SoC Post-Si Validation Engineer Lead/Manager (2003-2006)
•	Intel® RAID Controller Software Engineer (2001-2003)

positions.title: src Committer
positions.description:
* Lead developer and maintainer for the NVM Express drivers and utilities
* Lead developer and maintainer for the isci driver (Intel C60x integrated SAS/SATA controller)

patents.title: Computer program product, system, and method to manage access to storage resources from multiple applications
Systems and methods for isolating input/output computing resources
